Answers like these are not specific enough for awarding marks. Question 18, 19 and 20 Generally presented a challenge to the candidates, very few candidates answered them correctly. Summary Candidates should listen to the recording very carefully and develop techniques and strategies to enable them to identify and select appropriate detail for their answers. There is a need to increase one’s Hindi vocabulary to access some questions and also to focus on sounds and letters, paying particular attention to similar sounding letters. Candidates should gain as much practice as possible at listening exercises in class, and attempt past papers under timed conditions. This would certainly help to raise the overall standard.
